dataset: All 5000 COCO val2017 photos, sorted by original numeric filename, without selection by matches
integrity: HTTPS same public S3 bucket; bind bytes/ETag observed from official HTTP URL and HTTPS path-style bucket URL, record SHA256 and verify ZIP CRC. Multipart ETag is not an MD5 checksum or signed provenance.
imageRights: Images remain owned by respective copyright holders and subject to applicable Flickr terms. Local research cache only; no image redistribution or claim of CC0/CC-BY4 image licensing.
preprocessing: None: original JPEG bytes unchanged. Core and ORB use complete source dimensions for this cohort (each below default1m ORB pixel cap); no resized input or reduced ORB sampling.
split: Within each sorted prefix, even positions train and odd positions test; synthetic audit splits only, not COCO official train/test or contamination ground truth.
runBounds: At most 30 invocations per size/mode with one cache per size and separate cache for resume. Retain all stopping reasons/failures. No configuration tuning after results; any changed protocol is a new disclosed experiment.
acceptance: Default Core covers complete selected input under explicit finite budgets; otherwise record capacity failure.
Retrieval checks all selected candidate directions within bounded resumed calls, with candidateQueueComplete true; approximate pruned pairs still require complete false and exit2.
Cold/warm/final-resumed evidence identity equal, no dropped known witnesses, actual executed work and logical coverage separate.
Record wall time, cache payload bytes, host and child sampled RSS plus documented sampling limitations; do not claim process-tree hard isolation.
Force one process interruption on new resume cache after committed work; demonstrate actual feature/direction/query reuse and final identity parity.
scopeLimits: Full original-resolution Core and ORB capacity/recovery on all COCO val2017. Explicit finite raised total-pixel budgets; artificial audit splits and unlabelled natural relations. No population accuracy, new holdout or human timing claim. Cold means fresh product cache, OS page cache not flushed.
